description: This file declares the interface for a radix tree data structure used in the Lighttpd project, including functions for creation, deletion, insertion, removal, lookup, and iteration of radix trees.

methods.name: li_radixtree_new
methods.description: Creates a new radix tree instance.

methods.name: li_radixtree_free
methods.description: Frees the radix tree and optionally the data stored in its nodes.

methods.name: li_radixtree_insert
methods.description: Inserts data into the radix tree with a specified key and bit length, overwriting existing data if present.

methods.name: li_radixtree_remove
methods.description: Removes data associated with the specified key and bits, returning the removed data.

methods.name: li_radixtree_lookup
methods.description: Performs a longest prefix match query in the radix tree for the given key and bits.

methods.name: li_radixtree_lookup_exact
methods.description: Performs an exact match lookup in the radix tree for the given key and bits.

methods.name: li_radixtree_foreach
methods.description: Iterates over each element in the radix tree, applying the provided function.
